lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to change how a character looks with grow, shrink, hide and show blocks to tell a story.
The grow block makes a character bigger.
Use it twice to grow even more.
Shrink makes a character smaller — like Alice in Wonderland!
The bug eats 2 leaves (gems). After each leaf, it grows.
Munch, grow, munch, grow — what a big bug!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
